title: Archive component lookup
summary: Recover the archive's case-sensitive linked-entry component lookup at 0x5991e0, including its packed 18-bit name offsets and sentinel handling.
test_description: Compare original and recovered results for an empty chain, each of four name-offset banks, empty and nonempty strings, prefixes, case differences, misses, duplicate names and different chain starts; verify all fixture fields and name bytes remain unchanged.
known_limits: Entry field meanings beyond those used by lookup are inferred from callers and remain unresolved.
Invalid pointers, out-of-range indices, unterminated names and cyclic chains are not validated by the original and are outside the tests.
